provenance_note: R26-306 intake (2026-09-24). Part (b) of E99 s115, NVIDIA's investments, as FILED: non-marketable (private) + publicly-held equity securities at carrying/fair value. Carrying value, not cash invested - it includes unrealized gains (e.g. $7.5B in H1 FY27 on the private book alone). Equity-method stakes ($3.3B), the $25B of equity commitments and the $105B OpenAI-lease guarantee cap are kept OUT of the sum and named separately; the filings do not break the stakes out by company. This is the sourced raw material for the editorial 'NVIDIA funds its customers' page - a second, labelled construction, never a bigger pie slice.
